name: looot
description: One API key and prepaid balance for about 2,500 data endpoints from 90+ providers: work email, phone, company and people enrichment, company search, tech stack, Google SERP, web search, news and web page reading. The agent sees the price before a call and a failed call costs nothing. Hosted server with OAuth 2.1 or a Bearer key; prepaid from $5, no subscription.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. Sign in with OAuth 2.1 or send Authorization: Bearer <key>.

examples.title: Find a work email
examples.description: Look up a contact before outreach
examples.prompt: Find the work email for the head of sales at stripe.com and verify it.

examples.title: Enrich a company
examples.prompt: Enrich notion.so with headcount, funding and the tech stack it runs.

examples.title: Search Google
examples.description: Get SERP results for a query
examples.prompt: Show the top Google results for 'best CRM for startups' and read the first page.
